name: Constrained optimization of the academic alert policy

hypothesis.statement: Selecting a threshold under development CHANNEL excess-FAR plus 0.05 may improve G0_OFF academic compliance versus the original BETA policy without unacceptable detection loss.

G0_OFF_selection.required: Complete original selection membership, target months, onset labels, raw and calibrated probabilities; exact parent G0/canonical source pins and original predictor/global intercept; passing eight-cell evaluation reproduction and byte-identical recovery; verify all payload hashes.
G0_OFF_selection.substitution: G1, R0, L1, aggregates, partial intersections, refitted predictors and recalibrated probabilities remain inadmissible.

admission.rule: Admit only the exact authorized recovered selection manifest, all eight complete original cohorts, original model/global-intercept identities and successful existing recovery audits. No new inference during DELTA. Revision 2 and bounded implementation/execution are explicitly authorized by Mauricio; merge and scientific gate approval remain separate.

cohort.verification: Local recovery verified exact private evaluation keys, labels, probabilities and P0 alerts against the pinned benchmark: T+1 2653/313 and T+2 2422/219 rows/onsets. Complete selection cohorts verified against original role audits and embargo; recovery manifest records ordered membership hashes.
cohort.rule: Exact frozen BETA common ON/OFF evaluation cohorts, current non-excess, known H5 onset, original complete predictors and origin embargo; no intersections or removed rows.

P0.alerts: Copy verified original persisted alerts exactly.
P0.thresholds: Original frozen BETA thresholds; do not reselect.
P0.original_selection_rule: Maximize onset detections subject to at most one false onset alert per eligible municipality-year.

P1.predictor: Same G0_OFF cell as P0; same original global calibrator.
P1.probabilities: Exactly P0 probabilities; no training, inference or calibration.
P1.selection: One threshold per horizon/evaluation year; pooled original selection population, without territorial policies.
P1.objective: Maximize detected development onsets subject to FAR_excess_P1 <= FAR_excess_CHANNEL_development + 0.05.
P1.search: Only unique persisted development scores; alerts use score >= threshold, whole ties indivisible. Include no-alert as a candidate with undefined FAR; it is never automatically feasible.
P1.support: Both onset classes and both target-excess classes, defined CHANNEL FAR, at least one emitted P1 alert and one detected development onset; otherwise NO_EVALUABLE. No feasible threshold also yields NO_EVALUABLE, without fallback or evaluation-based reselection.
P1.margin_arithmetic: Use integer cross-products for the inclusive absolute 0.05 boundary, avoiding rounded FAR comparisons.
P1.freeze: Persist selected threshold, development counts and source identities before evaluating Y.
P1.unevaluable_application: Preserve all evaluation rows and P0; mark P1 unavailable for that cell, never as zero alerts. A horizon missing a P1 cell is NO_EVALUABLE for the full primary comparison; do not pool a partial cohort.

chronology.calibration: Target year Y-3; original fitted global intercept only.
chronology.adaptation: Target year Y-2; unused by G0_OFF.
chronology.selection: Target year Y-1; original BETA common eligibility and origin embargo.
chronology.evaluation: Target year Y; original BETA common eligibility and origin embargo.
chronology.verification: Per-cell roles reconstructed using pinned original code/canonical data and matched to original cells; selection disjoint from train/calibration/adaptation/evaluation within each cell. This is lineage-based verification, not independent attestation of historical fit calls.
chronology.selection_budget: CHANNEL FAR on that cell's development block only; evaluation CHANNEL FAR is used only for final acceptance.
chronology.forbidden: No threshold reselection after evaluation, future inputs or tuning on evaluation outcomes.

comparators.CHANNEL: cases(T) > H5 P75(target month), including P75=0; five same-month observations from target_year-5 through target_year-1, type-7 percentile, all history <= origin T.
comparators.PERSISTENCE: Known excess at origin T, projected to the horizon; zero alerts on the required current-non-excess cohort.
comparators.H5_onset: T+1: non-excess at T then excess at T+1. T+2: non-excess at T and transition from non-excess at T+1 to excess at T+2; continuations are not new onsets. Future states are outcomes only.

metrics.exposure: Eligible observed rows / 12; complementary load uses false onset alerts.
metrics.zero_alerts: FAR and precision undefined, not zero; unavailable required denominator yields NO_EVALUABLE.
metrics.probability_control: Verify exact ordered probability/label equality, calculate AP and Brier once per shared cohort, attach to both policies without independent redundant calculations.
metrics.strata: Each horizon independently; cross product of pooled/all four years and pooled/Meta/Tolima. Never infer stability from pooled compliance.

acceptance.primary: All A/B/C, independently for pooled T+1 and pooled T+2; undefined required denominator or missing P1 cell yields NO_EVALUABLE.
acceptance.interpretation: Lower FAR without preserved onset detection is not automatically an improvement; report paired gains/losses, 2022 and every temporal/territorial control.

responsibilities: Apply frozen P0/P1 to identical evaluation rows
Compute metrics and publish immutable results
implementation_after_admission.reuse: Compatible existing readers, academic_benchmark comparator/metric functions and atomic no-overwrite publication.
implementation_after_admission.registration: Add only necessary pipeline_registry.py, conf/base/catalog.yml, config_loader.py and configuration.py bindings; preserve strict validation.
validation: Whole score ties and exact threshold application
Focused Ruff/format/mypy and relevant technical tests
implementation_after_admission.publication: Source/code/protocol-bound manifest; detailed selection scores and municipality-month decisions only in data/, public compact aggregates only after verified real execution.

limits: All historical evaluation years have been analyzed previously; descriptive retrospective comparison only.
2024 is consumed stress, not independent confirmation; 2025 is excluded and is not a fresh reserve.
H5 is experimental; consolidated data do not establish historical operational availability.
Missing verified selection data is an admission blocker, not a negative hypothesis result.

Selection probabilities are explicitly reconstructed, not independently persisted historical arrays. No original selection digest exists; exact evaluation reproduction and repeated output equality provide consistency evidence only.
forbidden: New inference during DELTA; only the separately authorized, completed frozen-model recovery may supply the pinned selection artifact

revision_lineage.scope: Admit the pinned reconstructed selection source; authorize original P0/P1 comparison only.
